quest.title: Covert Investigation, Dirty Money Misdeeds
quest.description: All the clues surrounding the Dark Financier point to the auction. After making your final preparations, you get ready to visit the Hotel Debord...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, the mechanisms have been activated.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Now, all we have to do is wait for our target to take the bait...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know what? For some strange reason, Paimon's not nervous at all.

dialogues.speaker: "Dark Financier"
dialogues.text: My dear Monsieur Diderot... Here to make excuses for your complete failure at the auction, or to fish for a bigger cut?

dialogues.speaker: "Dark Financier"
dialogues.text: Accidents happen, of course. What I care about, is whether you have the spine to deal with the consequences...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: So, you do believe in consequences... Seems a bit ironic coming from the likes of you.

dialogues.speaker: "Dark Financier"
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: "Dark Financier"
dialogues.text: A trap, I presume? I've set a fair share of those myself. I suppose it's about time I stumbled into one set by someone else...

dialogues.speaker: "Dark Financier"
dialogues.text: No matter. Sometimes you take a chance on someone who turns out to be a disappointment... It's happened before.

dialogues.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
dialogues.text: It's not easy to earn the Dark Financier Rovere Pellicia's respect, but I must say, you three detectives are a force to be reckoned with. I suppose congratulations are in order...

dialogues.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
dialogues.text: Six months of planning and execution was all it took to take down a Mora-laundering organization decades in the making. I have to hand it to the Fontaine and Liyue authorities — your operation really has been a roaring success!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is the Dark Financier so... polite? Not the kind of crime boss Paimon was expecting!

choices.text: It's over!

response.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
response.text: Oh, do be serious. You thought you'd corner me, and then what? I'd just surrender?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: If you want to do this the easy way, then yes. You know you're out of options.

response.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
response.text: For two months, I've watched you and Officer Edler dismantle my organization piece by piece.

response.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
response.text: As you cut off my limbs, gouged out my eyes, deafened my ears... I was helpless to stop it.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: So you're planning on taking us down with you, is that it? Heh, never heard that one before...

response.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
response.text: My livelihood is in tatters, Agent Yelan. Hundreds I had working under me, hundreds — and now, they're either locked up or useless. Corder is the only one who still has some value...

response.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
response.text: My Mora-laundering days are over, we both know that. And considering how your operation's been progressing, it was only a matter of time before you locked onto me.

response.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
response.text: I'm usually one to quit while I'm ahead, but you see, there's only so much a man can lose before he starts to get rather... angry.

response.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
response.text: So, Agent Yelan, even if the only score I get to settle here today is ending your precious life — well, that's a high I'll ride straight to the bank!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, clockwork meka! Paimon takes back what she said! This isn't very polite at all!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: An old military model. Bet these go for big bucks on the black market...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You two have been a huge help. But this fight is mine.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Cause as it so happens, he isn't the only one who has a score to settle here. If he wants to bring on the drama, then I'm more than happy to give him a show.

choices.text: You'd better come quietly!

dialogues.speaker: Waitress
dialogues.text: Good evening, patrons. Allow me to escort you to the auction.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh... Paimon's getting a little nervous, but we gotta keep it together! This is our best chance to catch these guys!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Wow, this place is packed... Is every rich person in Fontaine here or something...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, wait, the people we're after are hiding here too. It's time to get serious! Paimon knows just the thing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What! It's not like we're rich like the rest of these people. We need a little something to blend in! Besides, if we're here as honest, hardworking detectives, we might as well look the part!

choices.text: I want a pair of detective glasses, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, too bad.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't have another. But, she'll help you make one once this is all over! An even cooler pair!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Well, you two seem raring to go. Good to see you're not nervous.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But remember — the key to blending into an event like this is remaining calm and collected. Slow your breathing, tone down the emotion... We don't want to stand out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—Y—Y—Yelan?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It is you, right? It must be you!

choices.text: I don't think we're the ones who need to worry about keeping a low profile...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Well, I am the current owner of Yanshang Teahouse, after all, as well as an honored guest at this auction.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: So, I thought something with more of a Fontainian flair might be nice. A special outfit for a special occasion... Why? Does it look bad?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no! Not at all!

choices.text: You look great!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Alright, well let the "vacation" begin. We have an auction to crash.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You two are expert investigators at this point. With us working together, I'd say our chances of success are stacked higher than the cake towers in the Hotel Debord.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We sure make a great team, but now that we're at the auction, what's our actual game plan?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: This time, your mission is simple. Take this dossier and pay attention to the items being auctioned.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: When the Dark Financier's "antiques" are up, all you need to do is bid. We want to drive up the price and create a bidding frenzy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so... We get to actually take part in the auction?

choices.text: Can we bid however much we want?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Thoughtless bidding usually leads to a warning, or even disqualification.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But the special account you two will be using during the bidding has no credit limit. So, you can drive up the price as high as you want. The more chaos we create, the better.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The Dark Financier knows we're on his tail, so I highly doubt he's sent one of his trusted agents here. The buyer is likely someone disposable, a scapegoat of sorts.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: After the incident with the ship, several buyers registered for the auction at the last minute. They're all wearing special pins signifying them as tea aficionados... Our target should be among them.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: And I'm sure he's terrified, because if a different buyer develops an interest in one of their inflated goods and wins the bid, it's game over for both Corder and the Dark Financier.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Not to mention, the buyer has limited funds at his disposal. The Dark Financier likes to work in small sums at a time, so his scapegoat can't go too overboard with the bidding.

choices.text: Got it. We need to put pressure on them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, so complicated stuff aside, the point is... They have a plan, and our goal is to mess it up. If Paimon was in their shoes, that would make her pretty nervous, too...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: There's seating reserved for special guests on the second floor. I'll be up there during the bidding to keep an eye on things. And to see if anyone starts to squirm.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: One thing going wrong might not be enough to slip him up. But, target him again and again, and trust me... He'll feel the heat.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Once the auction is over, we'll find somewhere secluded to corner the buyer and have a nice little "chat."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds like a plan. We won't let you down.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We're on a winning streak, and we're not about to let up!

choices.text: The more desperate they get, the better.
I'm gonna go all out!
It's perfect!
Next to the most dazzling lady in the room, we'll be invisible...
I want a detective mustache, too.

talks.objective: Equip the item and begin your investigation

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: (The time is right. I should start investigating.)

dialogues.speaker: Proud Buyer
dialogues.text: Wow! I can't believe I won the bid for this antique painted vase! Should be a wonderful addition to my home decor!

dialogues.speaker: Astonished Buyer
dialogues.text: Did you see those tea sets from Chenyu Vale? People were bidding on them left and right! My goodness, those final numbers... Far too high for my pocket book.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: *sigh*... This was not how it was meant to go. Where did those two come from?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Whatever your employer is offering you... The Maison Gardiennage will double it.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: You!

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: ...Ahem, I don't know what you're talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Is that so? Well, you might be interested to know that this hit man over here is also on a need-to-know basis.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: "If the person wearing the blue pin loses their bid, find somewhere secluded and eliminate them." All he can do is follow orders, I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: E—Eliminate?
You lucked out, kid! Getting cornered by the law just saved your life!

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: No no no no no, this can't be happening...

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: The boss said that even if I got sent to the Fortress of Meropide, all I had to do was keep my mouth shut, and he would find a way to get me out...

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: And he even paid me three million in advance! On that alone, I could get my wife the best medicine, help her hang on for a few more years...

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: But then, one auction goes wrong... Just one! And what? He's afraid I'm gonna talk? So now, I'm just collateral damage?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You're risking your life to do this guy's dirty work and pad his pockets with even more cash... Compared to what he's making, what you get in return are nothing but the scraps.

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: I've got at least seventy people just like you locked up in the Maison Gardiennage. Need them to tell you where this ends?

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: ...*sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: No need.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: I'm guessing... You're offering me a way out. What do you need me to do, officer?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: All you need to do is arrange a meeting with your boss and have a little chat.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: My boss... He's extremely careful about that kind of thing. I've only met him three times — to pick up the advance, to go over the plan, and to get the funds for the auction.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: The best I can do is take you to the place I'm supposed to deliver the goods. There's a certain method I can use to get in contact with him in case of emergencies.

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: Alright then. But first, we need to search your home for evidence related to the case.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Mission accomplished!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You managed to get through to him so fast, Yelan! Paimon almost couldn't believe it!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, he was already nervous and uncertain... All it took was a sincere negotiation. Once I laid his interests out on the table, it didn't take much for him to realize he stands to gain more with us than his boss.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Plus, we had some very convincing performances to help seal the deal. Especially you, officer. You make an excellent hit man.

dialogues.speaker: Fonck
dialogues.text: Ah, well. It's been a while since I've gotten to tap into a villain like that. Thought I could've pushed it a little more, honestly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you kidding? Paimon felt like she was face to face with one of our bad guys of the week!

choices.text: I knew it was fake, and I still felt myself tensing up.

response.speaker: Fonck
response.text: Well, what's next, Yelan? Want me to go after Corder or Doddamani?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The Sumeru authorities have Doddamani covered. They're just waiting on our signal, and they'll nab him once he makes it back to Bayda Harbor.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The Millelith are pursuing Scamface, so that just leaves Corder. Tail him, but be sure to keep your distance. We don't want him to tip anyone off.

response.speaker: Fonck
response.text: You got it! I love it when a plan comes together like this.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Alright then, we'll reconvene twelve hours from now, when our new double agent will lead us into the lion's den...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: It's time for the Dark Financier to face the music.

choices.text: If you needed a side hustle, you could always become a part-time actor!

dialogues.speaker: Waitress
dialogues.text: Good evening, patrons. Allow me to escort you to the auction.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: (Hm, he's acting strange, and there's something off with his attire. No mistake — that's our guy.)

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: (His tea afficionado pin is a special color... most likely to make it easier for Corder to keep tabs on him and the situation as a whole.)

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: (Which means, the two don't know each other well at all... That's something we can use to our advantage...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Once the auction is over, you all meet up outside the Hotel Debord. Officer Edler arrives with your new double agent in tow...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After checking the list of auction participants, you're able to confirm his identity. He turns out to be an ordinary clerk who ran into some financial trouble. Perhaps desperation was what drove him to take such a risk.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No time to waste. I'm ready!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, then let's see those detective skills in action.

talks.objective: Go to the goods delivery point

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: Alright, this is where the boss told me to bring the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: This area is full of apartments and warehouses for rent. The Maison Gardiennage came through not too long ago to keep trouble off the streets. I guess boss thinks it's safer to operate right under their noses...

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: Now, to arrange an emergency meeting, we need to activate a series of mechanisms to send him a signal.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: But to tell you the truth, I have no idea how to activate them. The only hint boss gave was that the code has something to do with colors.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: Maybe he was planning to give me more information after the auction, but that plan fell through, obviously...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was hoping it would be smooth sailing at this point! But no, of course, there's yet another obstacle...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, after all the investigating it took us to get this far, figuring out what to do with these mechanisms should be a piece of cake!

talks.objective: Equip the item and talk to Yelan
Wait for the target to arrive

dialogues.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
dialogues.text: Unbelievable... You've bested me, fair and square.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: "Any last words?"

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Ah, perhaps a bit too dramatic, isn't it? I'd rather not give a soapbox to a piece of scum like you.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No, I think I'll say my piece instead...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You can pretend to have "seen the error of your ways," but it doesn't matter — because you're going to rot in prison for the rest of your life, and every moment of every day, you'll be cursing the greed that put you there.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Every coin of dirty money that you've pocketed over the years is just another nail in your coffin.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: And all you'll be able to do is curl up in the corner of your cell like a dying animal, and waste away whatever remains of your pathetic life.

dialogues.speaker: Rovere Pellicia
dialogues.text: You're not a detective... No. You're some kind of demon!

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: If you knew what's good for you, you'd have walked away from this fight! But it's too late for that now.

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: Phew... After six months of hard work, I finally get to tick off the "mission accomplished" box at the end of the case file.

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: Take this guy back to the Court of Fontaine to stand trial. Don't let him try anything.

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: With any luck, we'll get to send him off to prison before the day is out.

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: #Oh, ahem, Miss Yelan, {NICKNAME}, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: ...As a personal thanks for all your help, you deserve half of the bonus I'm getting for this case! I will also request that the Maison Gardiennage extend our utmost thanks to our partners in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I appreciate the sentiment, Officer Edler, but that's too kind.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I was just doing my job. I can't, in good conscience, accept even a single Mora. I'll have to pass up any invitations for banquets or tea-tastings as well.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #If you want to reward someone for going above and beyond during this operation, it should be {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

choices.text: Oh... it wasn't anything special!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's had her detective cap on for so long, analyzing all those clues and trying to uncover their schemes, that her brain hurts! But, at the same time, she feels smarter than before!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe Paimon really does have what it takes to be a real detective!

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Well, if you're interested in this line of work, we're heading to the Maison Gardiennage to get a confession out of these guys. Did you want to tag along?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—You really mean it? Yes! One hundred percent yes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Is that okay, {NICKNAME}? Paimon's gonna go with Officer Edler and learn some cool new detective skills! Who knows, maybe they'll come in handy someday?

choices.text: Go ahead. Have fun!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, alright! Then, let's rendezvous outside the Palais Mermonia!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #Well, both our lives can get back to normal now, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: After talking about it for so long, I finally have the chance to enjoy a real vacation.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #Mind humoring me for a bit, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I'd be honored.
I'd be delighted.
Who better to watch over you than a police officer?
Well, if you insist!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Time to equip the <color=#00E1FFFF>Forensic Imaging Device</color> and take stock of the clues in this area.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If all goes to plan, this should be the last phase of the investigation. It's a shame, I know... But all good things must come to an end.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me just check I'm prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: (I still need to equip the <color=#00E1FFFF>Forensic Imaging Device</color> and record all the crucial pieces of evidence...)

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: Detective, I wanted to ask... Since I've cooperated with the investigation and all, do you think I'll get a lighter sentence?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: That's for the Maison Gardiennage and the court to decide... But, I think your attitude will work in your favor.

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: Phew... I'm glad I came to my senses when I did. Otherwise, I'd be done for, for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You follow the attendant to the auction site...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You begin your investigation at the meeting site marked by the scapegoat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, time to meet back up with Yelan. Our destination? A very important auction at the Hotel Debord!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is our chance to catch the culprit behind this whole scheme!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15500
dialogues.text: Most of the items at this auction originate from Chenyu Vale...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15500
dialogues.text: This hundred-year-old porcelain is simply exquisite...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15500
dialogues.text: The starting price is 15,000,000 Mora. Don't miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon guesses we're not messing around then...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15477
dialogues.text: What!? Don't you think you're raising a little too fast?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15500
dialogues.text: Wow! That's a very generous bid!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15500
dialogues.text: I have 18,000,000 in the room. Do I have any more bids?

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: ...I—I have no choice...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like we've really stirred things up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So this is how it's done...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Time to take some lessons from Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: How much!?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15478
dialogues.text: Did I hear that right!?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15477
dialogues.text: They don't put amateurs on the front row... Those guys don't mess around!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15500
dialogues.text: Wow, wow, wow! Our golden-haired guest here is really something else!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15500
dialogues.text: 25,000,000. Going once... Going twice...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#15500
dialogues.text: Congratulations, the item is yours!

dialogues.speaker: Astonished Buyer
dialogues.text: I wasn't expecting things to be this intense...

dialogues.speaker: Astonished Buyer
dialogues.text: It looks like I'm going to have to take this auction seriously!

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: I guess this isn't the end of the world...

dialogues.speaker: Diderot
dialogues.text: But I can't miss out on the next item.
